overview_description.description: Probo is a full service, web based digital print and fulfillment partner that delivers exclusively to resellers. This means that the reseller can offer its customers a wide range of services and products through Probo. From canvases, panels and posters to textiles, stickers and labels, everything fully automated and 100% own production. Probo is innovation. By continually anticipating changes or creating changes, Probo distinguishes itself in the digital print market. This reseller only model is unique in the digital print market.

about_short_description.short_description: Probo is a full service, web based digital print and fulfillment partner that delivers exclusively to resellers.

product.name: Digital Print and Fulfillment Services
product.description: Probo provides web-based digital printing and fulfillment services exclusively for print resellers, offering over 300 products and materials with on-demand printing and delivery.

product.name: 3M™ 480 Mc Wrapfolie
product.description: A PVC-free, stretchable wrap film suitable for complex 3D shapes and vehicle wrapping, with easy bubble-free application and removability without residue.

product.name: 3M Application Rollers
product.description: Specialized rollers for applying car wrap films, designed to remove air bubbles and excess adhesive during installation.

product.name: Canvas Company Accessories
product.description: Accessories for canvas products, supporting finishing and mounting options for printed canvases.

product.name: Printed Kitchen and Bathroom Backsplashes
product.description: Custom printed backsplashes designed for kitchens and bathrooms, offering heat, splash, and scratch resistance with easy cleaning and installation.

product.name: Panel Spacers and Mounting Holders
product.description: Hardware components such as spacers and side grip holders for mounting panels with or without drill holes, suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
